mintAuthority.summary: DAI minting is vault/module based, with DaiJoin moving Vat.dai into ERC-20 DAI and Maker/Sky governance controlling module authorization and debt ceilings through the Pause process.

controls.label: DaiJoin token adapter
controls.capDescription: DaiJoin mints ERC-20 DAI only against existing Vat.dai balances and burns DAI on join; it is not an unrestricted off-protocol issuer minter.
controls.evidence: Sky Chainlog lists MCD_JOIN_DAI at this address. At Ethereum block 25711852, DAI.wards(DaiJoin) returned 1 and eth_getCode confirmed contract bytecode. DaiJoin mints ERC-20 DAI only against existing Vat.dai balance, so it has no unrestricted off-protocol mint path and cannot raise its own accounting bound.

controls.label: Maker/Sky Pause Proxy governance executor
controls.capDescription: Maker/Sky governance executes through the Pause Proxy after the current 2-day Pause delay and can change system modules, collateral parameters, and debt ceilings via MCD_VAT.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711852, MCD_PAUSE.delay() returned 172800, MCD_VAT.wards(PauseProxy) returned 1, and eth_getCode confirmed PauseProxy bytecode. Governance can use the two-day delayed executor to authorize system modules and change Vat parameters and debt ceilings. DAI.wards(PauseProxy)=0 is expected because this authority reaches supply through Vat rather than direct token minting.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25711852, DAI.wards(0x9759a6ac90977b93b58547b4a71c78317f391a28)=1, MCD_VAT.wards(0xbe8e3e3618f7474f8cb1d074a26affef007e98fb)=1, and MCD_PAUSE.delay()=172800; both controls had bytecode. DaiJoin can mint only against existing Vat credit, while governance can raise system ceilings or authorize modules only through the two-day Pause path. The economic bound is therefore raiseable rather than unrestricted, and the on-chain Vat accounting path makes reserve reconciliation and prudential issuer supervision not applicable. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the two-day Pause independently delays ceiling and module changes, Vat issuance is on-chain collateral-accounted, and no prudential supervisor or independent attestor applies.
